answer: To join, an applicant must grow a trellis of verifiable work rooted in one attested device key: the registry publishes a fresh signal, each rung a seeded computation chained from the last, so the chain is strictly sequential and recheckable in seconds, each verified rung earning a sable seal that alone opens the gate. The k-th identity on one device must grow a trellis k rungs deep, so puppet costs stack 1+2+…+n. Making 1,000 puppets needs 500,500 rungs — about 167,000 GPU-hours, roughly $83,000 — while one honest user grows a single 20-minute rung for about $0.17.
